name: Economics Extended Minor
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: For a course to fulfil a prerequisite, or for a required course to be accepted in an economics program students must have a grade of C- or higher.

sections.note: Students should fulfil Faculty requirements early in their programs and obtain broadly based backgrounds before entering upper division courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In order to graduate from any ECON major, joint major, minor, or extended minor program, students must have a minimum ECON cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 2.0 and a minimum ECON cumulative upper division grade point average (CUDGPA) of 2.0, calculated on all ECON courses completed at SFU.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete the same lower division requirements as a major.

sections.title: Lower Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete the following prior to program declaration with a minimum grade of C- (unless otherwise indicated).

requirements.title: One of MATH 150, MATH 151, MATH 154, MATH 157
One additional 200 division ECON course (other than ECON 201, 220W, and 233)

sections.note: Students who earn a grade of A- or better at Simon Fraser University on their first attempt in ECON 201 are exempt from the requirement of one additional 200 division ECON course.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete at least 15 upper division ECON units following the completion of 60 lower division units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A maximum of eight ECON upper division units from another institution can be applied to the extended minor.

grades.label: Declaration Requirements
grades.text: Students are eligible to apply for entry to the program once 30 units have been completed, ECON 201 is completed with at least a C- grade, the minimum cumulative grade point average (CGPA) is met and the ECON program GPA is met.

grades.label: Declaration Requirements
grades.text: The department announces the minimum CGPA below which students will not normally be considered for entry to the program.

grades.label: Continuation in Program
grades.text: To continue in an economics program, students must maintain a 2.0 CGPA.

grades.label: Program Requirements
grades.text: In order to graduate from any ECON major, joint major, minor, or extended minor program, students must have a minimum ECON cumulative grade point average (CGPA) of 2.0 and a minimum ECON cumulative upper division grade point average (CUDGPA) of 2.0, calculated on all ECON courses completed at SFU.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: For all bachelor of arts (BA) programs, students complete 120 units, which includes at least 60 units that must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 45 upper division units, of which at least 30 upper division units must be completed at Simon Fraser University at least 60 units (including 21 upper division units) in Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences courses satisfaction of the writing, quantitative, and breadth requirements an overall cumulative grade point average (CGPA) and upper division overall CGPA of at least 2.0, and program CGPA and upper division program CGPA of at least 2.0 on the course work used to satisfy the minimum program requirements.

grades.label: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences Degree Requirements
grades.text: FASS departments may define additional GPA requirements for their respective programs.
